subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should Feishu gateway startup continue to wait up to the bot-info probe timeout before starting account monitoring, or should startup proceed promptly with bot identity recovery happening asynchronously/degraded?
rationale: That choice changes startup readiness and bot identity semantics, so automation should not decide it from source evidence alone without Feishu owner intent and live service proof.

options.title: Make startup non-blocking
options.body: Start Feishu transport promptly and move slow bot identity recovery onto the existing degraded/asynchronous path, with focused startup tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Keep the blocking probe
options.body: Keep the current startup probe semantics, but require live logs showing whether the reported delay is expected or needs a narrower timeout/default adjustment.

options.title: Document timeout tuning only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and document the existing startup probe timeout knob if maintainers decide the delay is operator-specific rather than a product bug.

recommendation.title: Make startup non-blocking
recommendation.body: Start Feishu transport promptly and move slow bot identity recovery onto the existing degraded/asynchronous path, with focused startup tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata names this handle as the Feishu community maintainer, and the issue timeline already routed the report there.
